title: Rice Big Grain1 enhances biomass and plant growth-promoting traits in rhizospheric yeast Candida tropicalis.
authors: Ekta; Biswas, Debarati; Mukherjee, Gayatri; Maiti, Mrinal K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水稻BG1基因在酵母中的异源表达对生长和促生性状的影响，仅提及OsBG1为DNA结合蛋白但无TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联薄弱。
abstract: The Big Grain1 (BG1) gene of rice (Oryza sativa L.) is reported to increase the yield of rice crops; however, its molecular mechanism is largely concealed. To explore its functional prospects, we have taken a structure-function-based approach. In silico analyses suggest OsBG1 is a DNA- and phytohormone-binding protein. Heterologous expression of OsBG1 with galactose-inducible promoter GAL1p in the rhizospheric yeast Candida tropicalis SY005 revealed 7.9- and 1.5-fold higher expression of the gene at 12 and 24 h, respectively, compared to the expression at 36 h post-galactose induction. Functional activity of the induced OsBG1 in engineered yeast increased cell density, specific growth rate, and biomass by 28.5%, 29.8%, and 14.1%, respectively, and decreased the generation time by 21.25%. Flow cytometry-based cell cycle analysis of OsBG1-expressing yeast cells exhibited an increase in the cells of the G2/M population by 15.8% after 12 h of post-galactose induction. The gene expression study of yeast transformants disclosed that OsBG1 regulates cell division by upregulating the expression of the endogenous gene cyclin B1 (CtCYB1) by 1.3- and 1.9-folds at 10 and 12 h, respectively, compared to the control, and is positively influenced by the phytohormone indole acetic acid (IAA). Further, the study revealed that OsBG1 significantly increases biofilm formation, stress tolerance, and IAA production in C. tropicalis SY005, implying its prospective role in enhancing plant growth-promoting traits in microbes. OsBG1-expressing rhizospheric yeast cells significantly improved the germination and growth parameters of the bio-inoculated rice seeds. Altogether, this study suggests OsBG1 can be employed to genetically improve suitable bio-inoculants for their plant growth-promoting traits to augment crop productivity. KEY POINTS: * In silico analyses suggested OsBG1 is a phytohormone-binding transcription factor. * OsBG1 enhanced growth in rhizospheric Candida tropicalis by upregulating CtCYB1. * OsBG1 improved plant growth-promoting traits of the rhizospheric yeast C. tropicalis.
abstract_zh: 水稻（Oryza sativa L.）的Big Grain1（BG1）基因据报道能提高水稻作物产量；然而，其分子机制在很大程度上仍不明确。为探索其功能前景，我们采用了基于结构-功能的方法。计算机模拟分析表明OsBG1是一种DNA和植物激素结合蛋白。在根际酵母热带假丝酵母（Candida tropicalis）SY005中，以半乳糖诱导型启动子GAL1p异源表达OsBG1，结果显示，与半乳糖诱导后36小时的表达相比，12小时和24小时时基因表达分别高出7.9倍和1.5倍。在工程酵母中，诱导的OsBG1的功能活性使细胞密度、比生长速率和生物量分别增加了28.5%、29.8%和14.1%，并使世代时间缩短了21.25%。基于流式细胞术的细胞周期分析显示，表达OsBG1的酵母细胞在半乳糖诱导后12小时，G2/M期细胞群增加了15.8%。对酵母转化体的基因表达研究表明，OsBG1通过上调内源基因细胞周期蛋白B1（CtCYB1）的表达来调控细胞分裂，与对照相比，在10小时和12小时时分别上调1.3倍和1.9倍，并受到植物激素吲哚乙酸（IAA）的正向影响。此外，研究还揭示OsBG1显著增加了热带假丝酵母SY005中的生物膜形成、胁迫耐受性和IAA产生，暗示其在增强微生物促植物生长特性方面的潜在作用。表达OsBG1的根际酵母细胞显著改善了生物接种水稻种子的萌发和生长参数。总体而言，这项研究表明OsBG1可用于遗传改良合适的生物接种剂，以增强其促植物生长特性，从而提高作物生产力。关键点：* 计算机模拟分析表明OsBG1是一种植物激素结合转录因子。* OsBG1通过上调CtCYB1增强了根际热带假丝酵母的生长。* OsBG1改善了根际酵母热带假丝酵母的促植物生长特性。
